scope: Art generation and packaging only. Viewed the exact v6e and v6d reference sheets before generation, all 30 built-in native generation outputs during production, all 80 final normalized poses, all 40 authored contact overlays, ten authentic south-facing Front Desk chair proofs, both style comparison sheets, all 326 existing catalog identities and all 20 nearest-reference/catalog comparison boards. styleAssessment: The ten inspectors retain the v6e/v6d adult cartoon family, dark outline, stepped transparent sprite finish, restrained cel shading and shared 160x320 normalization. Their blazers, cardigans, collared shirts, tailored trousers, office shoes, dark lanyards and blank badges distinguish them from the clinical staff. All use the same tan clipboard, blank cream paper and small metal clip per identity. Standing views retain anatomical right-side carriage: screen-left in S, near side in E, far side in W and screen-right in N. Seated boards rest across the right lap, with the supporting grip naturally partly hidden in W/N. Five women and five men span intended visual ages 28-65; two wear glasses. Hair, facial hair, skin tones and clothing combinations differ from the catalog and from one another. Appearance has no clinical or gameplay-selection meaning.
limitations: Rear seated clipboards are deliberately mostly occluded. Nine initial sheets had an upright rear clipboard and received built-in targeted edits; 009 already had a lap-level board. Final rear views expose only a thin right-side edge, so clipboard recognition at game scale remains a manager visual acceptance question.

In seated W views the clipboard is on the far right lap. The near left hand often overlaps the board, so the far right support/grip cannot be independently proven from visible pixels alone. The board edge is especially subtle for 004 and 006. 008 received a second targeted edit to expose a clear flat tan/cream lap board in W.

The intended petite, lean, broad and full builds render with subtler differences than the written design rows. Some inspectors have slightly slimmer torsos/longer-looking legs than the two v6e provider references, within the same anchored canvas and cel-shaded family. Manager should assess this degree of proportion/build variation.

004 renders a warmer, lighter golden-brown skin tone and rounder amber frames than her written medium-warm-brown/oval-frame brief. 005's white pixie is somewhat tousled, 006's quiff is fuller and wavier, and 009's silver sides are stronger than planned. All remain coherent across directions.

Intended ages are design metadata, not exact age recognition from art. Silver hair/moustaches and facial cues distinguish the mature cast, but the established stylized faces remain comparatively youthful.

Native extraction preserves imperceptible alpha-1 noise: 895 source footprint pixels outside the normalized frame across 16 poses, and 16 derived border pixels across seven poses, all maximum alpha 1. No protected-alpha clipping occurred. No thresholding, erasing, repainting, procedural character drawing or mirrored pose synthesis was applied.

Forty seated contacts are manually authored worker candidates, not manager approval. Ten chair proofs use the authentic south-facing Front Desk fixture and original runtime geometry; no invented chair rotations are presented as runtime fixtures.

The requested October 11 M0 owner follow-up was absent from the Level 5 plan version available at intake. The explicit worker brief supplied the binding inspector requirements. This art lane creates no runtime inspector job or hireability rule.

Browser gallery validation was attempted with an existing Chrome executable and fresh ephemeral file-gallery contexts, but launch failed with browserType.launch: spawn EPERM in the worker sandbox. Exact error logs are retained; the manager must rerun the prepared check. The captured 326-identity/2638-asset runtime baseline is unchanged. This batch is local and art-review-only; manager acceptance, integration, publication and GitHub backup are not claimed. No game origin, persistent browser profile or campaign storage was used.
